author: Brenton Kemp
title: Patrick Corbin struggles in no-decision versus Cubs Saturday
desc: Blue Jays left-hander Patrick Corbin allowed three earned runs on six hits and three walks in just 3 2/3 innings in a no-decision on Saturday against the Cubs.
impact: Corbin just wasn't right in this one, allowing three walks and a homer as part of six hits on the afternoon. Fortunately, the Blue Jays would let him off the hook with a late rally in an eventual 8-6 victory. After providing multiple serviceable starts as part of an injury-riddled Blue Jays rotation, Corbin hasn't completed four innings in each of his last three starts and has allowed 14 runs over his last four starts spanning 15 1/3 innings. He is tentatively scheduled to take on the Rangers at home next weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: DJ Herz (elbow) suffers setback
desc: DJ Herz will not make his scheduled rehab start on Sunday and could be shut down for multiple weeks.
impact: Herz experienced forearm tightness after his last outing. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Kazuma Okamoto hits three-run homer in win over Cubs Saturday
desc: Blue Jays third baseman Kazuma Okamoto went 1-for-3 with a homer and an additional run scored in an 8-6 win over the Cubs on Saturday.
impact: Okamoto capped the Blue Jays' comeback win with a three-run homer in the top of the eighth inning to give the club an 8-5 lead in an eventual 8-6 victory. The long ball was the rookie's 16th of the season as he is slashing .229/.310/.443 with 38 runs, 45 RBI, and a .753 OPS through 75 games.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Daulton Varsho launches three-run homer in win over Cubs Saturday
desc: Blue Jays outfielder Daulton Varsho went 1-for-4 with a three-run homer in a comeback 8-6 win over the Cubs on Saturday.
impact: With the Cubs ahead 5-0, Varsho launched a three-run homer to right field to get the Jays on the board in an eventual 8-6 win. The homer was Varsho's sixth of the season, as he proved his ailing wrist was just fine as he was activated from the injured list prior to Saturday contest.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Andrew Abbott hurls five innings in win over Yankees Saturday
desc: Reds left-hander Andrew Abbott went five innings and allowed just one earned run while earning the win in a 10-2 rout of the Yankees on Saturday.
impact: Abbott wasn't electric as he allowed five hits and three walks on the afternoon, but he did strike out six and allowed just one runner to cross home plate. The victory improved the southpaw to 5-4 on the season, although it appears he has been flirting with danger. He carries a 3.83 ERA through 16 starts, but his 4.88 xFIP and 5.03 SIERA suggest some regression should be had moving forward.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Wilyer Abreu goes deep in win over Mariners
desc: Wilyer Abreu went 1-for-3 in a win over the Mariners with a two-run home run, one walk, and two runs scored.
impact: Abreu continues a solid stretch at the plate, registering hits in six of his last eight contests with seven RBI. The outfielder remains one of the more reliable bats in an inconsistent Red Sox lineup, batting .275 with nine home runs, 36 RBI, 33 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 73 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Griffin Conine (hamstring) activated from IL
desc: The Marlins activated Griffin Conine from the injured list.
impact: Conine returns from a multi-month absence after undergoing left hamstring tendon surgery back in April. Christopher Morel was designated for assignment as the corresponding move.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Edwin Arroyo notches four hits in win over Yankees Saturday
desc: Reds infielder Edwin Arroyo went 4-for-5 with a double and a pair of runs scored in a 10-2 win over the Yankees on Saturday.
impact: The struggling Arroyo had himself a fine afternoon on Saturday, singling three times and adding a double and two runs scored in five trips to the plate. The 22-year-old has been solid defensively, but has slashed just .255/.308/.298 without a homer or a stolen base across 52 plate appearances so far in the big leagues.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Christopher Morel designated for assignment
desc: The Marlins designated Christopher Morel for assignment.
impact: Morel loses his spot on the Marlins 40-man roster. He is hitting just .162 on the season without a home run.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Caleb Durbin swipes two bases in win over Mariners
desc: Caleb Durbin went 2-for-4 in a win over the Mariners with two stolen bases and one RBI.
impact: Durbin has heated up at the plate, driving in runs in five of his last eight contests. The infielder remains one of many disappointing options in the Red Sox lineup, slashing .208 with five home runs, 29 RBI, 25 runs scored, and seven stolen bases across 67 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Woodruff (shoulder) to return Monday
desc: Brandon Woodruff will be activated from the injured list to start Monday's game against the Reds.
impact: Woodruff threw 82 pitches over 5 1/3 innings in his latest rehab start. He should not be facing any restrictions in his first start back from the injured list.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Spencer Steer homers, drives in three in win over Yankees Saturday
desc: Reds first baseman Spencer Steer went 1-for-5 with a three-run homer in a 10-2 win over the Yankees on Saturday.
impact: Steer got in on the action on Saturday with a three-run homer to left field in the fifth inning to help stake the Reds to a 6-1 lead at the time. The long ball was his 12th of the season as Steer is hitting .240 with 43 runs, 31 RBI, and a .752 OPS in 73 games. His .358 xwOBA is above his .331 wOBA, so Steer could have some runway moving forward.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Masataka Yoshida chips in hit and swipe in 5-1 win
desc: Masataka Yoshida went 1-for-4 in a win over the Mariners with one stolen base.
impact: Yoshida has heated up at the plate, picking up hits in each of his last five contests. The 32-year-old continues to fight consistency issues at the plate for manager Chad Tracy, batting .248 with one home run, 10 RBI, 15 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 50 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ali Sanchez close to going on paternity list
desc: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Ali Sanchez is close to going on the paternity list.
impact: When Sanchez is away for a few days, J.C. Escarra will return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Johan Rojas (elbow) undergoes surgery Friday
desc: Johan Rojas underwent surgery on Friday to repair the ulnar collateral ligament in his right elbow.
impact: Per Lauber, the typical recovery is 6-8 months. The Phillies expect he'll be ready to begin next season.
